paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Saul in Philistia mite va delh ahong paikik in ngai in, "En-gedi gamdai ah David a-om," chih hilh in a-om hi.
heading: David In Saul Hinna Ahawi

paite: Huchi in Saul in Israel mi tengteng lak a telkhiak tuam mi sangthum api a, sathakte tenna suangpi lak lam ah David leh amite zong in ahohta uhi.
Lamkal ah belam huang kokhuk omna ava tung ua, khawl tawldam ding in Saul ava lut hi. Kokhuk sunggil lam ah David leh amite a-om uhi.

David mite'n akiang ah, "Ngai dih, TOUPA'N na kiang ah, ngai in, na khut ah na melma ka hon pe dia, atung ah hoih na saksak in na hih ding, achih ni ahita ve," achi uhi. Huchi in David athou a, simthamtak in Saul puan mong ava tan hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, aden chiang in Saul puan mong ava tan in David lungsim asun mahmah hi.
Huchi in amite kiang ah, "Amah TOUPA sathau nilh ahi, chih thei napi a, atung a khut zang a TOUPA sathau nilh ka toupa tung a hiai thil ka hih louh ding hi a," achi hi.
David in huai thu in amite akhamdai a, Saul sual dia akuan uh aphalta kei hi. Saul bel kokhuk a pan apawt a, apai nawnta hi.
Anung zek in David leng athou a, kokhuk a pan apawt a, "Kumpipa, ka toupa," chi in Saul anungsap hi. Nunglam ah Saul ahong kihei a, David in amai a lei si in akunsuk hi.
David in Saul kiang ah, "Ngai in, David in na siatna azong, chi a mite'n na kiang a, agen uh bangziak a gingta na hia?

Ngai in, tuni in TOUPA'N kokhuk ah ka khut ah nang ahon pia chih na mit mahmah in na mu hi. Mi khenkhatte'n nang that ding in ahon chi uh. Himahleh ka hon hawi hi. Ka toupa tung ah ka khut himhim ka kha kei ding, TOUPA sathau nilh ahi ngal a," ka chi hi.

Huai kia leng hilou in, pa, en in, na puan mong leng ka tawi hi. Na puan mong ka tan theih a, ka hon thahlouhna ah ka khut ah thil hoih lou leh tatlekna a-om kei, chih leh ka hinna lak tum in hon zongzong lechin leng, na tung ah ka khial kei chih thei in.
TOUPA'N nang leh kei kikal ah vaihawm henla, TOUPA'N na tung ah ka phu hon laksak hen. Himahleh ke'n zaw na tung ah khut ka kha kei himhim ding.
Nidanglai a paunak in, "Migilou a pan gitlouhna apawt zel," achi hi. "Himahleh ke'n bel na tung ah khut ka kha kei ding.
Israel kumpipa kua zong in ahia ahong pawtkhiak? Kua ahia na delh? Ui sisa, uihik lel mo?
Huaiziak in TOUPA vaihawmpa hi henla, nang toh kei kikal ah vaihawm hen, hon mu in hon genpih henla, na khut a pan hon hunkhia hen," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, David in Saul kiang a hiai thute agen khit in, Saul in, "Hiai ka tapa David aw hilou amaw?" achi hi. Huchi in aw suah in Saul akapta hi.
David kiang ah, "Kei sang in na diktatzaw, nang zaw ka tung ah thil hoih na hih a, ke'n bel thil hoih lou ka hih.
Tuni in ka tung a thil hoih na hihdan na hihlang a, TOUPA'N na khut a kei ahon piak a leng na hon thahlouhna ah.
Mi'n amelma mu taleh bangmah lou in akhah mawk diam? Huaiziak in tuni a ka tung a na thilhih ah TOUPA'N thil hoih in nang họn thuk hen.
Ngai in, kumpipa na hong hi ngei dia, Israel gam na khut ah hihkip in a-om ding chih ka theita hi.
Huaiziak in ka nung a ka suan hong om dingte hihmang lou ding in TOUPA min in ka kiang ah kichiam inla, ka pa inkote a pan ka min thaimang ke'n," achi hi.
Huchi in Saul kiang ah David akichiam hi. Huchi in inn ah Saul apai a, David leh amite leikohawm ah apaitou uhi.
